events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 today.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to shake, rattle, and roll through the generations.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day, the hip-hop world marks the anniversary of the tragic shooting incident involving Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas, who would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering a hip-hop icon today. The impact of Tupac Shakur's music and message still resonates decades on.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers the iconic guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970 and would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since the world lost a true guitar visionary. Jimi Hendrix's sound remains as electrifying as ever.

events.title: Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Celebration
angles.copy: That iconic zebra crossing. Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us the masterpiece that is 'Abbey Road'.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde. Still fronting The Pretenders with that unmistakable voice.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on this day in the UK in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates just as powerfully today.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember when your entire music library fit in your pocket? Twenty-five years since Apple launched the original iPod and changed how we listen forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the enduring legacy of the iconic 007 film franchise.

angles.name: James Bond Celebration
angles.copy: License to thrill! Happy James Bond Day to all the 007 fans out there. What's your favourite Bond film or theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The world remembers John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the inimitable John Cleese. From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedic genius.

events.title: Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Celebration
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that still sparks debate and delight.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world remembers the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991 and would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost one of the greatest showmen in music history. Freddie Mercury's voice and legacy are truly immortal.

events.title: Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Celebration
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw them push new boundaries.
